hypothesis: On the reused public t=0..59 development data, cutting only the decision-close budget from 500 to 250 dollars with unchanged entry gates will improve mean net episode profit, reduce worst loss and maximum marked drawdown to at most 51% of parent, and leave entry counts unchanged with zero rejected fills, over all t=20..52 paired episodes. Otherwise retain the parent. This is a risk-reduction hypothesis, not improved timing or alpha.
provenance: Declared after reviewing match-2 scoreboard and prior in-sample metrics, before this new replay; reused development data, not an independent preregistration or unseen validation. One candidate, no sweep.
